Game Overview

Dama Stars puts players into a checkers experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Dama Stars is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Dama Stars?

Dama Stars is a free checkers game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Dama Stars free to play?

Yes, Dama Stars is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
